_comment: Race gear drops (design/gdd/race-gear-sets.md 3.12, design/gdd/drops-and-rewards.md 3.8; Boss 2026-11-13). Race pieces are not extra rolls: after a normal drop (a per-kill item of data/loot/loot.json, or a wave chest) has rolled its tier and slot, with the share for that tier the piece BECOMES a race piece of the same slot and tier (slots in `slots` only). Its race and class are those of one squad card picked uniformly (so the race always comes from the squad that played, and the piece fits that card). `wave_shares`: by the wave the monster belongs to (the first bracket whose to_wave covers it). `chest_shares`: by the chest's wave. `boss_shares`: a drop of a boss_types monster (data/races/rules.json). Gold (legendary) race pieces come ONLY from the boss, and every boss legendary is a race piece (share 1.0). Every number is a PLACEHOLDER.
